content.json:
# Umbraco Load Test Dashboard
Queries `LoadTestSummary_CL` populated by `scripts/publish-load-test-results.ps1`. Filter at the top scopes Trends / Compare / Runs; the Tiers section ignores it deliberately (it's the cross-tier view).

parameters.name: Scenario
parameters.label: Scenario
parameters.query:
LoadTestSummary_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(180d)
| distinct scenario
| where isnotempty(scenario)
| order by scenario asc

parameters.name: Version
parameters.label: Version
parameters.query:
LoadTestSummary_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(180d)
| distinct umbraco_version
| where isnotempty(umbraco_version)
| order by umbraco_version asc

parameters.name: Tier
parameters.label: Tier
parameters.query:
LoadTestSummary_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(180d)
| distinct infra_tier
| where isnotempty(infra_tier)
| order by infra_tier asc

content.json:
## Trends
One line per `(version × tier)` over time. Toggle the metric with the picker below. Each chart has a foldout matrix view with median ±stddev across runs in the cell.

content.query:
LoadTestSummary_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where '{Scenario}' == '*' or scenario == '{Scenario}'
| where '{Version}' == '*' or umbraco_version == '{Version}'
| where '{Tier}' == '*' or infra_tier == '{Tier}'
| where isnotempty(scenario_name) and parse_status == 'ok'
| extend series = strcat(scenario_name, ' · ', umbraco_version, '/', infra_tier)
| project TimeGenerated, series, value = column_ifexists('{Metric}', real(null))
| where isnotnull(value)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: {Metric} per sampler over time

content.query:
LoadTestSummary_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where '{Scenario}' == '*' or scenario == '{Scenario}'
| where '{Version}' == '*' or umbraco_version == '{Version}'
| where '{Tier}' == '*' or infra_tier == '{Tier}'
| where isnotempty(scenario_name) and parse_status == 'ok'
| extend value = column_ifexists('{Metric}', real(null))
| where isnotnull(value)
| summarize med = round(percentile(value, 50), 1), sd = round(stdev(value), 1), n = count() by scenario_name, umbraco_version, infra_tier
| extend cell = strcat(med, ' ±', sd, ' (n=', n, ')')
| project scenario_name, umbraco_version, infra_tier, cell
| order by scenario_name asc, umbraco_version asc, infra_tier asc
content.title: Matrix view (median ±stddev)

content.json:
## Tiers
Latest run per tier for one `(scenario, version)`. Answers "what do I get for upgrading the tier?" Ignores the global filter bar — pick from below.

parameters.name: TiersScenario
parameters.label: Scenario
parameters.query:
LoadTestSummary_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(180d)
| distinct scenario
| where isnotempty(scenario)
| order by scenario asc

parameters.name: TiersVersion
parameters.label: Version
parameters.query:
LoadTestSummary_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(180d)
| where '{TiersScenario}' == '' or scenario == '{TiersScenario}'
| distinct umbraco_version
| where isnotempty(umbraco_version)
| order by umbraco_version desc

content.query:
LoadTestSummary_CL
| where scenario == '{TiersScenario}' and umbraco_version == '{TiersVersion}'
| where isnotempty(scenario_name) and parse_status == 'ok'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by infra_tier, scenario_name
| extend value = column_ifexists('{TiersMetric}', real(null))
| project scenario_name, infra_tier, value
| order by scenario_name asc, infra_tier asc
content.title: {TiersMetric} per sampler, latest run per tier

content.query:
LoadTestSummary_CL
| where scenario == '{TiersScenario}' and umbraco_version == '{TiersVersion}'
| where isnotempty(scenario_name) and parse_status == 'ok'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by infra_tier, scenario_name
| project scenario_name, infra_tier,
          p95 = round(p95_ms, 0),
          p99 = round(p99_ms, 0),
          ['err %'] = round(error_rate * 100, 2),
          ['plan cpu max %'] = plan_CpuPercentage_max,
          ['sql dtu max %']  = sql_dtu_consumption_percent_max
| order by scenario_name asc, infra_tier asc
content.title: Per-sampler + server-side detail per tier

content.json:
## Compare
Pick two runs to see per-sampler + server-side deltas. Drops outside the global filter — the dropdowns query the full history.

parameters.name: Baseline
parameters.label: Baseline run
parameters.query:
LoadTestSummary_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(180d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, run_id, scenario, umbraco_version, infra_tier) by run_id
| project value = run_id, label = strcat(format_datetime(TimeGenerated, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), ' · ', scenario, ' / ', umbraco_version, ' / ', infra_tier, ' (#', run_id, ')')
| order by label desc

parameters.name: Candidate
parameters.label: Candidate run
parameters.query:
LoadTestSummary_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(180d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, run_id, scenario, umbraco_version, infra_tier) by run_id
| project value = run_id, label = strcat(format_datetime(TimeGenerated, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), ' · ', scenario, ' / ', umbraco_version, ' / ', infra_tier, ' (#', run_id, ')')
| order by label desc

content.query:
let baseline = LoadTestSummary_CL | where run_id == '{Baseline}' and isnotempty(scenario_name);
let candidate = LoadTestSummary_CL | where run_id == '{Candidate}' and isnotempty(scenario_name);
let threshold = todouble('{Threshold}') / 100.0;
let delta = (a:real, b:real) { iif(a == 0 or isnull(a) or isnull(b), real(null), (b - a) / a) };
baseline
| join kind=fullouter (candidate) on scenario_name
| extend sampler = coalesce(scenario_name, scenario_name1)
| project sampler,
          base_count = request_count,  cand_count = request_count1,
          base_avg   = avg_ms,         cand_avg   = avg_ms1,
          base_p95   = p95_ms,         cand_p95   = p95_ms1,
          base_p99   = p99_ms,         cand_p99   = p99_ms1,
          d_avg = delta(avg_ms, avg_ms1),
          d_p95 = delta(p95_ms, p95_ms1),
          d_p99 = delta(p99_ms, p99_ms1)
| order by sampler asc
content.title: Per-sampler delta
Server-side delta

content.json:
## Runs
All runs matching the global filter. Paste a run ID into the field below to see per-sampler detail for that run.

content.query:
LoadTestSummary_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where '{Scenario}' == '*' or scenario == '{Scenario}'
| where '{Version}' == '*' or umbraco_version == '{Version}'
| where '{Tier}' == '*' or infra_tier == '{Tier}'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by run_id
| project Started=TimeGenerated, Scenario=scenario, Version=umbraco_version, Tier=infra_tier, ['Run #']=run_id, Commit=substring(commit, 0, 8), Status=parse_status
| order by Started desc
content.title: Runs

content.query:
// Drill-down: paste a run_id into the parameter to see per-sampler detail for that run.
LoadTestSummary_CL
| where run_id == '{DrillRun}' and isnotempty(scenario_name)
| project Sampler=scenario_name,
          Reqs=request_count, Fails=failure_count,
          ['Err %']=round(error_rate*100, 2),
          Avg=round(avg_ms, 0), p50=round(p50_ms, 0), p90=round(p90_ms, 0), p95=round(p95_ms, 0), p99=round(p99_ms, 0), Max=round(max_ms, 0)
| order by Sampler asc
content.title: Per-sampler detail for selected run
